exercises.question: Which form is the future subjunctive?

exercises.sentence: Los socios abonarán la cuota antes del día diez.
exercises.english: Members are to pay the fee before the tenth.

exercises.sentence: Los socios ____ de cumplir el reglamento.
exercises.english: Members are to comply with the regulation.

exercises.sentence: Todo socio que ____ la cuota a tiempo mantendrá su parcela.
exercises.english: Any member who pays the fee on time will keep his plot.

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: En caso que haya dudas sobre el plazo, la junta decidirá.
En caso de que hay dudas sobre el plazo, la junta decidirá.
En caso de que haya dudas sobre el plazo, la junta decidirá.

prompt.speaker: Carlos
prompt.text: En el reglamento antiguo pone «quien no abonare la cuota».

options: Quiere decir «quien no abonó la cuota».
Quiere decir «quien no abone la cuota».
Quiere decir «quien no abonaría la cuota».

exercises.english: Non-payment of the fee may lead to a penalty.

exercises.sentence: Si el socio no abonare la cuota en enero, perderá la parcela.
options: If the member had not paid the fee in January, he would have lost the plot.
Because the member did not pay the fee in January, he lost the plot.
If the member does not pay the fee in January, he will lose the plot.

template.prompt: Give the modern equivalent of «quien incumpliere el plazo», with the present subjunctive.
Using «habrán de», say that the members must respect the regulation (use «reglamento»).
template.answer: Los socios habrán de respetar el reglamento.

template.prompt: Using «el incumplimiento» and «será motivo de», say that failing to comply with the regulation will be grounds for expulsion.
template.answer: El incumplimiento del reglamento será motivo de expulsión.

template.prompt: Using «salvo que» and the subjunctive of «avisar», say that the contract is renewed (use «prorrogarse») unless one of the parties (use «alguna de las partes») gives notice.
template.answer: El contrato se prorrogará salvo que alguna de las partes avise.

exercises.english: Members who wish to hand over their plot must notify it in writing.
